name: Style Outfit Tower! [Would You Rather] ✨
desc:
Next Update at 100 Likes!

✨ Welcome to Would You Rather: Style Outfit Towers! 💖

Choose a door and build your perfect outfit one choice at a time. ♡

Every doorway gives you something new:
🎀 Cute outfits, hair and accessories
💀 Or something that could completely RUIN your outfit

Climb through 4 towers with different aesthetics:
💗 Kawaii Tower
🖤 Goth Tower
🦋 Y2K Tower
🍄 Cottagecore Tower

See what your final outfit looks like at the top!

✨ Every run gives you different items, play again for a new outfit!

❤️ LIKE + FAVORITE for more outfits and updates!

llm.loop: climb tower floors -> pick one of several doors -> receive an outfit item or a ruin -> reach the top to see the final outfit -> replay for a new outfit
llm.objectives: build a cute final outfit by choosing doors while climbing four aesthetic towers
llm.progression: four themed towers (Kawaii, Goth, Y2K, Cottagecore); otherwise mostly per-run
llm.instructions: choose a door to build your outfit one choice at a time; climb 4 towers; see your final outfit at the top; replay for a new outfit
unique: would-you-rather door choices combined with an outfit/dress-up tower obby
llm.thumbnails: faceless blank avatar facing three doors labeled KAWAII, GOTH, Y2K, each with a styled girl avatar and a question mark
llm.complexity_notes: linear towers, door triggers that apply accessories, simple troll products
